void-black.$description: Void Black — Hero background, dramatic dark sections — the opening stage of the experience

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Primary text, button text, icon fills — the dominant ink across all surfaces

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary text, muted nav, helper labels — softer than pure black for hierarchy

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary text, inactive nav items, disabled states

silver.$description: Silver — Placeholder text, very subtle UI dividers

soft-graphite.$description: Soft Graphite — Dark button backgrounds on light surfaces — secondary action fill

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary page canvas and white card surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

bone.$description: Bone — Page canvas, nav backgrounds, base surface beneath cards

linen.$description: Linen — Button fills, pill backgrounds, header wash — slightly warmer than Bone, the dominant secondary surface

lime-wash.$description: Lime Wash — Accent background wash, highlight zones, editorial color punctuation

saffron.$description: Saffron — Secondary accent wash, warm highlight zones

spectrum-marquee.$description: Spectrum Marquee — Sweeping rainbow gradient — the brand's signature motion element, traveling across hero and section dividers

exposure-variable.$description: Display headlines — the 112px whisper-weight serif that anchors hero and section titles. Its 0.85 line-height vertically compresses letters, making headlines feel carved and monumental rather than airy. Signature choice: anti-convention weight (300, not 700) and negative letter-spacing (-0.03em) create authority through restraint. Substitute: Playfair Display or DM Serif Display at weight 400 with tight tracking.

exposure-var.$description: Section headings and large nav — the bold companion to Exposure Variable. Used for 'Dia reads between the tabs' and feature titles. Tighter tracking at -0.05em at 48px gives headline density. Substitute: Inter Tight or a condensed grotesque.

abc-oracle.$description: Body text, UI labels, subheadings, and large feature headlines (54px at weight 300). The workhorse font — its humanist sans quality keeps long-form copy legible at generous line-heights (2.19 for body). Weight 500 used sparingly for emphasis. The 54px weight 300 headline is the secondary display voice, lighter than Exposure VAR but in the same serif-adjacent register. Substitute: Söhne or Inter at matching weights.

abc-oracle-triple.$description: Button text, inline labels, UI microcopy — a narrower variant of Oracle designed for button and tag contexts. The wide line-height (2.19) suggests single-line button use with internal padding breathing. Substitute: Inter at 16px weight 400.

abc-favorit-mono.$description: Eyebrow labels, step numbers (01, 02, 03), navigation metadata — all-caps at 13px with 0.1em tracking creates the editorial chapter-marker effect. The mono face contrasts with Oracle's humanist sans, creating typographic tension.
